name: mutagen-remote-skill
description: The mutagen-remote and mutagen-setup skills, which teach coding agents to use the remote executable of the zlcwwhq/mutagen fork and to set it up.

plugins.name: mutagen-remote
plugins.description: Teaches coding agents to run commands on the other side of a Mutagen synchronization session with the remote executable and resolve conflicts with it, and to set up Mutagen, its daemon, and a project's sessions.
